name: HYPR L1StandardBridge reinitialization
summary: HYPR's L1StandardBridge implementation wraps initialize() in a clearLegacySlot modifier that zeroes storage slot 0, which also holds Initializable's version, so reinitializer(2) passes on every call. The attacker reinitialized the bridge with its own contract as messenger and, as that messenger, finalized a withdrawal of the bridge's escrowed HYPR.
notes: HYPR has no DefiLlama price; it is valued at what the attacker realised (rule 15): the 20 sells of the 2.57M HYPR into the HYPR/WETH pair 0xeefaa1be within 135 blocks returned 97.3176 WETH, priced at $2,164.89 per ETH.
The two later initialize calls by 0xd4e69b4b moved no tokens and are not campaign transactions.
